caption: The drawing features a single metallic object composed of several distinct parts, all illustrated in shades of gray with subtle blue and brown accents to emphasize texture and material. At the base is a roughly oval-shaped, shallow tray with an indented section and a small circular compartment on one side. Attached to this base on the right is a curved vertical support that extends upward and then bends outward. Affixed to the upper end of this support is a shield-shaped plate with multiple cutouts and notches along its edges, and a small, pointed extension at its bottom. At the top of this plate, a loop holds a large, dark hook that curves horizontally, extending upward and to the left. The background consists of a blank, off-white rectangle centered within a slightly darker and aged border. There are no additional objects or details in the drawing.
title: Lamp
